<!--''''''-->(Japanese: '''３びきめ：ホゲータ''' ''3rd Monster: {{tt|Hogator|Fuecoco}}'') is the third chapter of the [[Pocket Monsters ~The Detouring Volt Tacklers!!~]] manga. It was first published in the November 2023 issue of ''[[Ciao]]'', released on October 3, 2023.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20231007024112/https://www.shogakukan.co.jp/magazines/0613911123 ''Ciao'' November 2023 issue | Shogakukan] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kise_ricca/status/1709176549331869745 Ricca Kise on Twitter] (Japanese)</ref> It is eight pages long.
